title: Convention Over Configuration
youtube_title: Convention Over Configuration: Why Boring Code Bases Make Great Agents | The Agentic Crew, Ch. 7
description: The same agent writes senior-grade code in a consistent code base and a mess in an inconsistent one. This chapter explains conventions as implicit context and long-term memory. It covers what belongs in an AGENTS.md instruction file, and the progression from instruction file to skill to hook.
